newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $25.73 million in treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $25.73 million in treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 512.8 million rupees (25.73 million dollars) in Treasury bills, out of a total of 700 million rupee that it put on tender sale on Thursday, the central bank said.

The bank said it sold 75.0 million rupees of 91-day, 60.8 million rupees of 182-day and 377.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.95 percent, 10.18 percent and 10.10 percent, respectively.
This week's effective bank rate has been posted at 10.34 percent per annum from 10.01 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 700 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day Treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.61 percent, 9.87 percent and 10.05 percent, respectively.
